sessions.label: HVAC service-21 probe: 21F2 -> NRC 0x11 (SNS)
sessions.notes: Probe of HVAC (0x7B3) DID 21F2 while READY/parked. ECU returned negative response 7F 21 11 (serviceNotSupported). Confirms HVAC (UDS) does not answer service 0x21 at F2 — one data point in the P2 service-21 sweep backlog.
